title: Encounter
effect: Roll on an encounter table. Possibly hostile. (See Reactions.)

title: Sign
effect: A clue, spoor, track, abandoned lair, scent, victim, etc is discovered.

title: Environment
effect: Surroundings shift or escalate. Water rises, ceilings collapse, a ritual nears completion, etc.

title: Loss
effect: Torches are blown out, an ongoing spell fizzles, etc. The party must resolve the effect before moving on.

title: Exhaustion
effect: The party must rest (triggering another roll on this table), add a Fatigue, or consume a ration.

title: Quiet
effect: The party is left alone (and safe) for the time being.
